items.title: Joseph Daley interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, March 18, 2018
items.q: things can be seen as better because we have Oprah Winfrey and these other people that have done very well for themselves

ctx.x: Wow. Thanks for sharing that. What do you say when someone says, “Yeah but things are much better than they used to be”?

Well for some and everything. But you know if you look at the data of fallen African- American men and women, through no fault, they haven’t done anything. I mean I think the numbers are still pretty high and everything and all. So the thing is, things can be seen as better because we have Oprah Winfrey and these other people that have done very well for themselves and everything. But there was a very interesting report, I don’t know if you saw that, coming out of Boston, that says like the average white family…
Obama being born in Kenya. I mean the data is there to say that, but then they say that almost 30% of the population still thinks that he was born in Kenya and he’s a Muslim.
